scope: Public-source desk review; no external project built, executed, reproduced, or calibrated in this survey

method.stars: GitHub REST stargazers_count; per-repository UTC timestamps retained
method.citations: OpenAlex cited_by_count for one explicitly selected work record per table row; not Google Scholar or a sum across versions
method.technical_evidence: Official repository READMEs; observed default-branch content SHA-256 retained; these are mutable source URLs, not pinned experiment revisions
method.license: GitHub automatic detection except explicit source notes; null and NOASSERTION are unresolved, not permission or a finding that no license exists
method.selection: Academic influence and GitHub popularity are parallel inclusion criteria. Retain all identified direct candidates, including maintained successors and complementary tools. Integration priority is separate from inclusion. Not an exhaustive census of all public software.
